supporting_observations.claim: The observed periodic HTTPS proxy connections are attributable to C:\Users\ben.carter\AppData\Local\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe: the process was launched in the background at 13:37:57, and its network events correlate with proxy connections to update.chartmate-imaging.net.

The supplied records show repeated requests to update.chartmate-imaging.net at 13:38, 13:43, 13:47, 13:52, 13:58, 14:03, and 14:08 UTC—roughly five-minute intervals. Several proxy requests succeeded, while others returned 407 or 502.

This activity differs from the inventory description: the observed updater is under the user's AppData\Local path rather than the listed Program Files path, and it connects to update.chartmate-imaging.net rather than the listed update.chartmate-imaging.com. These discrepancies warrant verification but do not by themselves establish maliciousness.
A file-create event for the same cmupdate.exe path was logged immediately after the 13:38 connection; the record does not establish what created or wrote the file.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT destinations and tunnel metadata, not the HTTPS contents or downloaded payload; for example, the 13:38 request records a tunnel to update.chartmate-imaging.net but not its content (T015-00110).
The provided records do not include a hash, signature, version, or full file lineage for the AppData\Local cmupdate.exe (T015-00108, T015-00114).
The supplied matching HTTPS records begin at 13:38 UTC, so they do not independently corroborate the alert's stated 13:30 start.
claims_not_established: Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is controlled or authorized by ChartMate, or whether it is malicious.
Whether the AppData\Local executable is a legitimate ChartMate updater, a modified binary, or an impostor.
Whether successful proxy tunnels transferred an update, other content, or any malicious payload.
Whether the file-create event at 13:38 represents a legitimate updater self-update or other file activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the updater's file hash, Authenticode signature, version, and process/file lineage; compare them with a verified ChartMate release.
Verify with ChartMate or the organization's software owner whether the .net hostname and per-user AppData installation are authorized; check the hostname's DNS and TLS certificate details.
Collect available proxy or endpoint telemetry that identifies the HTTPS response and any downloaded file, and determine whether the file-create event was caused by the updater.
unrelated_findings: WS-BCARTER-01 made an SMB connection to FILE-HD-01 that was logged on the server as ANONYMOUS LOGON using NTLM; investigate separately, and do not use it to determine this HTTPS alert (T015-00253, T015-00255, T015-00257).
